metadata.description: Function-hook mods that ship beside the agent-scripts skills.

plugins.name: grok-bot-watch
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: watches a Grok Bot bot by UUID over a read-only CDP sidebar read and wakes this session when a new reply lands: after the running turn's next tool result when a turn runs, else as a prompt. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: session-recall
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: a numbered list of what a session made (URLs, artifacts, files, images, commits). Write #aN in a prompt to hand Claude the exact ref and whether it is still up; Claude looks them up with its assets tool, even after compaction. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: agent-should-know
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: sends each card of the built-in You should know mod (cc-plugin-you-should-know), with its Learn more explanation, to the main agent (while a turn runs: its line after that turn's next tool result, or the whole card as a prompt when the turn ends if no tool result came; otherwise the whole card as a prompt), hides the card, and logs the card with the agent's verdict in one file per session under ~/.local/state/agent-should-know/. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: owner-asks
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: keeps raw owner messages and their provenance, derives the existing compaction projection, reminds once after resume, and provides read-only /asks. No judge or relay. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: quick-say
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: seven owner combos on digits 4-9 and 0 (前情提要 → 規劃期 → 指揮 → 驗收 → 收工) and three modes. 手動 only fills combos; 半自動 adds the git and "shall I?" gates; 自動 also sends 續跑 or 驗收 itself and stops on a question, a guess it cannot make, or four mod prompts in a row. Every mod prompt approves nothing. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: byo-provider
plugins.description: Function-hook mod: /provider-switch answers the main loop, a subagent or a fork with a model on your own Anthropic-format gateway (turn.step takeover); every other loop stays on Claude. Env untouched; the Claude credential is never sent to the gateway. Gateway URL/token/provider live in plugin options, not here. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
